articles.title: 1985년 당시 보도: 케닐워스 로드의 관중 난동

events.title: Both sides miss a penalty as 에버턴 draw 1–1 at 맨체스터 유나이티드, enabling 토트넘 홋스퍼 to close the gap at the top to two points with a 1–0 win at 스토크 시티. 맨체스터 시티 replace 블랙번 로버스 as leaders in the Second Division with a 1–0 win at Ewood Park . 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 are beaten 3–0 by 버밍엄 시티, their first league defeat at home in nearly a year. 찰턴 애슬레틱 fight back from 3–0 down to win 5–3 against 반즐리 for whom Ron Futcher scores a hat-trick and is later sent off.

Over 100 people are arrested after serious crowd trouble disrupts the second leg of the Milk Cup semi-final between 첼시 and 선덜랜드. The Wearsiders win 3–2 to reach the final 5–2 on aggregate. In the FA Cup fifth round, 사우샘프턴 suffer a surprise home defeat to 반즐리 while a late goal by Alan 선덜랜드 gives 입스위치 타운 a 3–2 win over 셰필드 웬즈데이.

An Andy Gray hat-trick helps 에버턴 to a comfortable win over 포르튀나 시타르트 in the Cup Winners' Cup while 리버풀 gain a useful 1–1 away draw with Austria Vienna in the European Cup. In the UEFA Cup, 맨체스터 유나이티드 narrowly beat Videoton but a 스티브 페리먼 own goal against 레알 마드리드 consigns 토트넘 홋스퍼 to their first ever home defeat in European competition. 노리치 시티 beat 입스위치 타운 2–0 at Carrow Road to reach the Milk Cup final. In FA Cup replays, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 윔블던 5–1 with Tony Cottee scoring three while 왓퍼드 and 루턴 타운 draw 2–2 after extra time at Vicarage Road .

노먼 화이트사이드 scores a hat-trick as 맨체스터 유나이티드 make the FA Cup semi-finals with a 4–2 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 입스위치 타운 take 에버턴 to a replay with a 2–2 draw at Goodison Park. 루턴 타운 beat 왓퍼드 1–0 to reach the sixth round. Midfielder Wayne Turner scores the only goal on his 24th birthday.
리버풀 win 4–0 at 반즐리 in the FA Cup with 이언 러시 notching up yet another hat-trick.
A 2–1 win at 토트넘 홋스퍼 pushes 맨체스터 유나이티드 back into contention for the league title. Three players are sent off in the goalless draw between 스토크 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언.

Another explosion of football violence occurs as 밀월 hooligans riot before, during and after their team's FA Cup quarter-final tie at 루턴 타운 which ends in a 1–0 win for the home side. 에버턴 complete the semi-final line-up with a 1–0 replay win at 입스위치 타운.
On his return from injury, 브라이언 롭슨 scores shortly after coming on as a substitute in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–2 draw at 웨스트햄 유나이티드.

토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 리버풀 at Anfield for the first time since 1912 to move level on points with leaders 에버턴. Garth Crooks scores the only goal in the 71st minute. 선덜랜드 win 3–1 at 노리치 시티 in a dress rehearsal for next weekend's Milk Cup final.

A mixed night for English clubs in Europe. 리버풀 and 에버턴 make it through to their respective semi-finals but 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 are knocked out of the UEFA Cup. Spurs have 스티브 페리먼 sent off in their goalless draw with 레알 마드리드 (0–1 aggregate) and United lose on penalties to Videoton.

오스발도 아르딜레스 marks his first appearance of the season with the opening goal in 토트넘 홋스퍼's 5–1 win over 사우샘프턴. 에버턴 beat 아스널 2–0 to virtually extinguish the Gunners' waning championship hopes. Hat-tricks for 맨체스터 유나이티드's 마크 휴스 against 애스턴 빌라 and John Wark for 리버풀 at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. In the Second Division, 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 move up to second with a 3–0 win over leaders 맨체스터 시티.

노리치 시티 win the Milk Cup. The significant action takes place in the space of five minutes at the start of the second half as Gordon Chisholm deflects an Asa Hartford shot into his own net for the only goal and 선덜랜드's Clive Walker misses a penalty.
The North American Soccer League announces that it will suspend operations for the 1985 season.

Two goals by reserve midfielder Kevin Richardson give 에버턴 a 2–1 win at 사우샘프턴 which takes them three points clear of 토트넘 홋스퍼, who lose 2–0 at home to 애스턴 빌라. 맨체스터 시티's lead in the Second Division is cut to two points after a 2–2 draw with bottom club 카디프 시티. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드, 버밍엄 시티 and 블랙번 로버스 all win while 포츠머스 draw at 슈루즈버리 타운.
맨체스터 유나이티드 stay in the championship race as a 프랭크 스테이플턴 header gives them a 1–0 win at 리버풀.
